sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: An exhibition showcasing how news of the Holocaust reached Britain earlier than widely understood was viewed by MPs at Portcullis House in September and is touring the UK. sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Former pastor Caleb Flynn is on trial in Ohio charged with aggravated murder, felonious assault, and tampering with evidence over the fatal shooting of his wife, Ashley Flynn, on 16 February. Prosecutors allege Flynn shot his sleeping wife twice in the head to be with his girlfriend, Alleigha Botner, and staged a home invasion. Flynn has pleaded not guilty. His defence team stated that having an affair does not make him a murderer. Botner testified that Flynn repeatedly discussed wanting his wife dead and sent her AI-generated love songs.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The trial is expected to conclude by the end of next week and will resume on Monday.

gist: Papua's rare tropical snow and glaciers are disappearing due to global warming.
The melting ice destroys a vital spiritual anchor and cultural landscape for Indigenous Papuans.
Scientists are racing to document the final remnants of the shrinking ice.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Nearly all the eternal snow and glacier cover on Papua's Sudirman Range has vanished, shrinking dramatically from thousands of hectares in the 19th Century to a tiny fraction around Puncak Jaya today.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The disappearance erases a crucial historical climate archive and destroys a deeply sacred landscape that holds immense spiritual significance for Indigenous groups like the Amungme and Moni people.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The remaining small patches of snow around Puncak Jaya are expected to disappear entirely within a year or two.
